title: Operator: cap run_task title argument length

investigation.trigger: standing instruction to keep shipping real, tested improvements to the Command Hub Operator Console
investigation.finding: args.title flowed unbounded from the tool boundary into deriveVtidTitleFromPlan()/allocateAndRegisterVtid() (operator-execution-onramp.ts), which already truncates the final candidate to 140 chars before it reaches vtid_ledger — so the stored value was never at risk, but the tool-argument boundary itself had no cap or log line, two frames upstream of that slice

fix.mechanism: soft cap (truncate, not refuse) at 200 chars, applied at the executeRunTask() call site before triggerOperatorExecution(); logs once via console.info only when truncation actually occurs; empty/whitespace/non-string resolves to undefined exactly as the prior inline check did

live_verification: not performed — autopilot_run_task is gated behind OPERATOR_EXECUTION_ONRAMP_ENABLED and OPERATOR_VTID_SELF_ALLOCATE_ENABLED (both default-off) and this session has no live Operator Console access; the next real signal is a real call with an over-length title logging the truncation line on staging
